governance_standard: PreDoc Clinical Data Governance v2.2 (ISO 27001 / HIPAA Compliant Provenance)

sources.title: Handbook of Signs and Symptoms
sources.description: Comprehensive clinical reference of cardinal signs, symptoms, etiologies, physical examination maneuvers, and urgent red flag indicators.

sources.title: Professional Guide to Signs and Symptoms
sources.description: Detailed clinical diagnostic handbook covering presentation, patient history taking, physical examination, diagnostic tests, and differential diagnosis.

sources.title: WHO ICD-10-CM Official Guidelines for Coding and Reporting
sources.description: Official international classification of diseases and diagnostic coding matrix.

sources.title: CDC Stacks & Public Health Clinical Practice Guidelines
sources.organization: US Centers for Disease Control and Prevention (CDC)
sources.description: Evidence-based guidelines for infectious diseases, outbreak triage, environmental exposures, and vaccination protocols.

sources.title: NCBI / PubMed Clinical Query Database & NLM Medical Subject Headings (MeSH)
sources.description: PubMed clinical query filters, systematic reviews, and MeSH indexing for rare diseases and differential diagnosis.

sources.title: ACC/AHA Clinical Practice Guidelines for Cardiovascular Disease
sources.organization: American College of Cardiology / American Heart Association
sources.description: Guidelines for STEMI/NSTEMI management, heart failure (ADHF/HFrEF/HFpEF), aortic dissection, and dysrhythmias.

sources.title: AAD Clinical Practice Guidelines
sources.description: Guidelines for melanoma, psoriasis, atopic dermatitis, bullous pemphigoid, and severe cutaneous adverse reactions.

sources.title: Endocrine Society Clinical Practice Guidelines
sources.description: Guidelines for DKA, adrenal insufficiency, thyroid disorders, Cushing syndrome, and pheochromocytoma.

sources.title: ACG Clinical Guidelines for Gastrointestinal Disorders
sources.description: Guidelines for acute GI bleeding, appendicitis, pancreatitis, inflammatory bowel disease, and cirrhosis.

sources.title: ASH Practice Guidelines for Hematologic Disorders
sources.description: Guidelines for DIC, immune thrombocytopenia, sickle cell crises, PNH, and aplastic anemia.

sources.title: IDSA Guidelines for Infectious Diseases
sources.description: Guidelines for bacterial meningitis, sepsis, endocarditis, Lyme disease, opportunistic infections, and malaria.

sources.title: APA DSM-5-TR Clinical Guidance
sources.description: Diagnostic criteria for major depressive disorder, schizophrenia, bipolar disorder, panic disorder, and delirium.

sources.title: ACR Clinical Guidance for Rheumatic & Musculoskeletal Diseases
sources.description: Guidelines for septic arthritis, rheumatoid arthritis, systemic lupus erythematosus, gout, and vasculitis.

sources.title: AAN Practice Guidelines for Neurological Disorders
sources.description: Guidelines for acute ischemic stroke, subarachnoid hemorrhage, status epilepticus, Guillain-Barré, and MS.

sources.title: ACOG Practice Bulletins & Clinical Guidance
sources.organization: American College of Obstetricians and Gynecologists
sources.description: Bulletins for preeclampsia/eclampsia, ectopic pregnancy, placental abruption, OHSS, and endometriosis.

sources.title: NCCN & ASCO Clinical Practice Guidelines in Oncology
sources.description: Guidelines for oncological emergencies (SVC syndrome, spinal cord compression, tumor lysis syndrome, febrile neutropenia).

sources.title: AAO & AAO-HNS Clinical Practice Guidelines
sources.organization: American Academy of Ophthalmology / AAO Head and Neck Surgery
sources.description: Guidelines for acute angle-closure glaucoma, retinal detachment, epiglottitis, quinsy, and sudden sensorineural hearing loss.

sources.title: AAP Pediatric Clinical Practice Guidelines
sources.description: Guidelines for pediatric croup, RSV bronchiolitis, Kawasaki disease, febrile seizures, and neonatal jaundice.

sources.title: AUA & KDIGO Clinical Practice Guidelines
sources.organization: American Urological Association / KDIGO Kidney Disease Guidelines
sources.description: Guidelines for acute kidney injury, nephrotic syndrome, testicular torsion, nephrolithiasis, and pyelonephritis.

sources.title: ATS / ERS Clinical Practice Guidelines for Respiratory Medicine
sources.organization: American Thoracic Society / European Respiratory Society
sources.description: Guidelines for acute pulmonary embolism, ARDS, asthma exacerbations, COPD, tension pneumothorax, and idiopathic pulmonary fibrosis.

sources.title: AACT Clinical Practice Guidelines for Medical Toxicology
sources.description: Guidelines for acetaminophen toxicity, organophosphate poisoning, carbon monoxide, opioid toxidrome, and heat stroke.

sources.title: AGS Beers Criteria & Geriatric Care Guidelines
sources.description: Guidelines for delirium (CAM criteria), frailty, pressure injuries, polypharmacy cascades, and atypical presentations in older adults.

sources.title: Surviving Sepsis Campaign & SCCM Critical Care Guidelines
sources.description: Guidelines for septic shock, cardiogenic shock, CICO emergencies, malignant hyperthermia, and LAST protocols.

sources.title: ACMG Practice Guidelines for Clinical Genetics
sources.organization: American College of Medical Genetics and Genomics
sources.description: Guidelines for Marfan syndrome, vascular Ehlers-Danlos, Huntington disease, metabolic storage disorders, and porphyrias.

sources.title: AAPM & NHPCO Practice Guidelines for Pain & Palliative Care
sources.organization: American Academy of Pain Medicine / NHPCO
sources.description: Guidelines for CRPS, trigeminal neuralgia, breakthrough cancer pain, opioid hyperalgesia, and palliative symptom control.
